task: Reconcile 233 regional glacier mass change estimates over 19 RGI regions (2000-2023) into annual regional and global time series in m w.e. and Gt with uncertainties.
reconciliation_principle: Within each region, (1) resample each input series onto the GlaMBIE monthly grid then aggregate to annual; (2) form group-level estimates per method as inverse-variance weighted means with empirical+formal uncertainty; (3) combine across method groups by inverse-variance weighting using GlaMBIE-style weighting that downweights the noisier groups, propagating uncertainty including method spread.
